title: 第11章 全家人钓鱼第12章 我叫武林
content_zh:
“张昊宇一睁眼，就见俩小不点，一左一右安静地看着自己。”
“见他醒来，俩小不点立马把小脸蛋贴过来，奶声奶气地喊着：‘二锅，二锅，糖没’！”
张昊宇跟俩小不点疯闹了一会儿，“二哥起来拿好吃的！”
他一个鲤鱼打挺从床上蹦下来，从书包里掏出两个苹果，给俩小不点妹妹一人一个！
俩小不点哪见过苹果呀，拿在手上翻来覆去地看。“吃呀，可好吃了！”
俩小不点这才轻轻咬破一点皮，吧唧吧唧嘴，觉得有点甜，不过酸味比甜味重！
这个年代的水果，还没改良呢，确实没有后世的好吃！“但它纯天然无污染，也没有科技与狠活，是难得的好东西……”
张昊宇把剩下的六个苹果也拿了出来，“晓丽小天，快来呀！”
姐弟俩听到二哥的呼喊，立马跑了进来。
张昊宇给了他们一人一个苹果！
剩下的四个递给晓丽，“拿去给娘。”晓丽用衣角兜着苹果去了厨房。
“娘，二哥让给你的。”母亲接过四个苹果，拿到自己房间放到柜子里……
母亲跑到张昊宇房间，“小宇，苹果哪来的？
“大学采购员给的！”母亲看到两个小不点，人手一个苹果，都才刚刚咬破一点皮。
“他们俩小丫头，一个苹果吃不完，吃着也费劲，切成小块给他们一人一块就行！”
张昊宇看了看两个小不点也笑了，小嘴太小，咬不到苹果。“来，二哥给你们把苹果掰开。”
小不点很听话，把苹果递给了过来！
把苹果掰成两半，用意念把苹果种子收到空间里，然后给他们一人一半苹果，这样就能咬到了。
他又把另一个苹果掰开，递给母亲一半，“娘，咱俩一人一半，你也尝尝！”
母亲接过苹果，拿到厨房用刀切成小块！过来给两个小丫头一人一块。

把两个小不点手里半个苹果换下来，一小块就够她们两个吃了。
把两半个苹果递晓丽小天各一半，整个的自己放好，明天再吃，一会吃饭了，张昊宇看了一圈还能这样？
这要是开始把苹果都给母亲，应该是一个苹果，切成八块，一人小一块。
张昊宇心里美滋滋地想，过不了几天，空间里就会有吃不完的苹果了。
他兴高采烈地从书包里掏出橘子，递给母亲，“娘，你帮大家分着吃吧！”
母亲看着橘子，惊讶地问：“还有啊？”
弟弟妹妹们都眼巴巴地盯着橘子，虽然没吃过，但也都很是好奇。
母亲微笑着，“明天再吃吧，这两天，点心、糖、苹果，可把你们美坏了！好东西可不能一下子吃完！”
母亲拿着橘子，回到自己房间，小心翼翼地放到柜子里，然后又回到厨房。
小天好奇地问：二哥，“那是啥呀？好吃吗？”
张昊宇笑着回答：“那是橘子，也是水果。”
“明天让娘拿给你们尝尝，就知道了！”
张昊宇心里想着也就释然了，这个年代物资匮乏，可不像后世物资那么充足。
现在是国家刚起步的阶段，又赶上灾年，能填饱肚子就已经很不错了，有吃的东西哪能一下子就吃完。
可不是每个人都像自己这样，有空间外挂，还有前世几十年的经验，还有一身兵王的本事！
这个年代的人，那才是靠自己的真本事生活！哪像后世的很多人，遇到占地拆迁，就一下子大富大贵，衣食无忧了！
有些有关系的人赶上经济开放的好时机，就像坐火箭一样，一飞冲天！
有句话说得好，把猪放到风口上，猪也能飞起来！后世确实有很多人靠吃政策红利，一下子就发达了！
content_en:
"As soon as Zhang Haoyu opened his eyes, he saw two little ones, one on the left and one on the right, looking at him quietly."
"When they saw him wake up, the two little ones immediately put their little faces towards each other and shouted in a sweet voice: 'Second pot, second pot, no sugar left'!"
Zhang Haoyu and the two little ones had a wild fuss for a while, "Second brother, get up and get some delicious food!"
He jumped out of bed like a carp, took out two apples from his schoolbag, and gave one to each of his two little sisters!
The two little ones had never seen apples before. They held them in their hands and looked at them over and over. "Eat it, it's delicious!"
The two little ones then bit the skin lightly and smacked their lips. They thought it was a bit sweet, but the sourness was stronger than the sweetness!
The fruits of this era have not yet been improved, and they are indeed not as delicious as those of later generations! "But it is purely natural and pollution-free, without technology or harsh labor. It is a rare good thing..."
Zhang Haoyu also took out the remaining six apples and said, "Xiaoli Xiaotian, come quickly!"
The siblings heard the second brother's call and ran in immediately.
Zhang Haoyu gave each of them an apple!
The remaining four were handed to Xiaoli and said, "Take them to mother." Xiaoli carried the apples in her clothes and went to the kitchen.
"Mom, my second brother gave it to you." Mother took the four apples, took them to her room and put them in the cabinet...
Mother ran to Zhang Haoyu's room, "Xiaoyu, where did the apple come from?
“Given by the university buyer! "The mother saw two little ones, each holding an apple, and they had just bitten a bit of the skin.
"The two little girls can't finish an apple, and it's hard to eat it. Just cut it into small pieces and give them one piece each! "
Zhang Haoyu looked at the two little ones and smiled. The little mouths were too small to bite the apple. "Come on, second brother, break the apples open for you. "
The little one was very obedient and handed the apple over!
Break the apple in half, use your mind to hold the seeds into space, and then give each of them half of the apple so they can bite into it.
He broke another apple open and handed half of it to his mother, "Mom, each of us has half, you can try it too! "
The mother took the apple and cut it into small pieces with a kitchen knife! Come here and give each of the two little girls a piece.
Replace half an apple in the hands of the two little ones, and a small piece is enough for them both.
He handed two halves of apples to Xiaoli and Xiaotian, and put the whole one away by himself. He would eat it tomorrow. After eating for a while, Zhang Haoyu looked around and could he still be like this?
If you start giving all the apples to your mother, it should be one apple, cut into eight pieces, one for each person.
Zhang Haoyu thought happily that in a few days, there would be endless apples in the space.
He happily took out an orange from his schoolbag and handed it to his mother, "Mom, please share it with everyone! "
The mother looked at the oranges and asked in surprise: "Is there more?" "
The younger brothers and sisters were all staring at the oranges eagerly. Although they had never eaten them, they were all very curious.
The mother smiled and said, "Let's eat it tomorrow. In the past two days, the snacks, candies, and apples have made you beautiful!" Don’t eat all the good stuff at once! "
Mother took the oranges, returned to her room, carefully put them in the cabinet, and then returned to the kitchen.
Xiaotian asked curiously: Second brother, "What is that?" Is it tasty? "
Zhang Haoyu replied with a smile: "Those are oranges and also fruits. "
"Let me give it to you to taste tomorrow and you will know! "
Zhang Haoyu felt relieved when he thought to himself. Materials in this era were scarce, but not as abundant as those in later generations.
Now is the country's initial stage, and it is also a year of disaster. It is good to be able to fill our stomachs. There is nothing to eat at once.
But not everyone is like me, with space plug-ins, decades of experience in previous lives, and the ability to be a warrior!
People in this era can only live by their own abilities! Unlike many people in later generations who suddenly became rich and had no worries about food and clothing when they encountered land demolition!
Something relevantWhen people catch up with the good opportunity of economic opening, they are like riding a rocket, soaring into the sky!
There is a saying that goes well, if you put a pig on the wind outlet, the pig can fly! There are indeed many people in later generations who have become rich all of a sudden by taking policy dividends!
